min_source: NEC 352.20(A): rigid PVC conduit smaller than 1/2 in trade size is not used (the specification's minimum raceway size governs where it gives one)
conductors_source: rule: a branch or site circuit buried below the slab or in the earth pulls its own conductors in its own raceway: the panel schedule's wire, never under what its breaker allows (NEC 240.4, Table 310.16), upsized for the voltage drop over its buried length (NEC 210.19(A) Informational Note No. 4); a one-pole circuit its neutral; one equipment ground for the raceway, sized for its largest breaker (NEC 250.122(A), (C)) and upsized with its phase conductors (250.122(B))
raceway_source: rule: the raceway the smallest PVC its conductors' fill allows (NEC Chapter 9 Table 1, Table 4 PVC, Table 5 THHN/THWN-2), never under the minimum
length_source: the voltage drop is worked at the circuit's whole load over all its buried run (its home run and the links between its loads): the most the load can see

kinds.feeder: a feeder's buried leg (the feeder schedule's conductors)
kinds.branch: a branch circuit of the building buried below the slab
kinds.site: a site circuit (poles, signs, chargers, gates, site equipment) buried in the earth
kinds.service: a utility service's conduit (primary or secondary)
